claims.statement: ERock 10-Q (Q2 2026): designs, deploys and operates natural-gas distributed power systems primarily for data centers, utilities and C&I customers; Contracted Power System Sales Backlog about USD 1.7 billion at 2026-06-30, up USD 1.5 billion year on year — but Q2 revenue fell 41.7% to USD 39.9 million, and four counterparties made up 28%, 13%, 13% and 11% of Q2 revenue. Backlog has not yet turned into revenue; the customers are not named in this document.

sources.quote: At the core of our power systems is our RockBlock (“RockBlock”), a modular, distributed generator string that incorporates our proprietary natural gas engine, scales in 0.5 megawatt (“MW”) increments from 1.5 MW to 3.5 MW per RockBlock and is assembled in-house.
The Company primarily serves data centers, utilities, and commercial and industrial customers across the United States.
Contracted Power System Sales Backlog as of June 30, 2026 was approximately $1.7 billion, an increase of $1.5 billion, as compared to June 30, 2025.
For the three months ended June 30, 2026, sales to four counterparties accounted for approximately 28%, 13%, 13% and 11% of the Company’s total revenue.
Furthermore, global supply chains for essential components, such as transformers and turbines, face multi-year backlogs and lead times ranging from 15 to 24 months.
